instructions: Display this bundled ClawHub metadata entry from the local SDKWork Skills seed.
Do not execute remote code from this artifact until the community package has passed SDKWork review.
Randomly generates one or more words from a curated database of 300 must-know College English Test Band 4 (CET-4) vocabulary.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Switch from Python to shell-based implementation; Python scripts removed.
- Skill now reads vocabulary directly from local word.txt instead of dynamic script generation.
- Updated usage: extracts words from word.txt and returns details using "#" as field separator.
- SKILL.md revised with new usage instructions and format example.
